argument: The remembered refusal must be carried by the downstream contour switching sides around a later receiver and by the shared lead/return gait, not by the gold knot or dotted handoff thread drawn over a stable body.

With witnesses and labels hidden, a viewer should identify one animal whose later outline changes side at a receiver and whose feet share the same alternating order. If it reads as a decorative zigzag, the mutation fails.
A visitor relay must change downstream contour and route coordinates, while unlinking the latest relay must reproduce the exact prior state from pointer, button, and keyboard paths.

Passing-on is an easy social metaphor. Delete v008 if hiding the witness marks leaves only a generic kink, if the feet do not inherit one relay order, or if the prose explains more handoff than the SVG body can show.
